info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Market Operation Securities Fails Processings-spec
info.description: This API enables users to access and retrieve information about market operation securities that have failed processing. It serves to identify and analyze instances of processing failures, providing insights into system performance and operational efficiency. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, operations teams, and risk management professionals who require up-to-date data on securities processing issues. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their troubleshooting capabilities and improve overall transactional integrity.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details regarding the processing of securities fails within the market operations. Utilize this to understand and analyze any outstanding fails and their resolution processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding securities fails processing. It encapsulates the criteria and parameters necessary for the GET operation.
